question: did the system reach the right outcome
ground_truth_shape: full case to expert grade and expert disposition, where the disposition is one of the four review dispositions the G4 gate accepts
why_empty: MUST BE HUMAN LABELLED, and no human labels exist. A decision case pairs a whole application with the grade and disposition a recruiting expert would have reached. Synthesising it from a model would measure agreement with that model rather than quality, which is the standing rule W7.1 restates without exception.
why_not_drawn_from_production: There are no applications. readypick-pilot holds three tenants and thirty jobs and zero applications, zero reports and zero evaluations (docs/verification/AI_UPGRADE_BASELINE.md, taken 2026-09-09). A decision case cannot be drawn from a system that has never decided anything.
what_would_unblock_it: Applications that have been assessed end to end in a deployed environment.
Expert recruiter hours to state the grade and the disposition independently of what the system produced.
Failure replays, which W7.1 budgets at 10% of the set: these require real incidents, and a system with no applications has had none.
